title: Replace ambient dimension by joint-support dimension, with an N<=r^a corollary
statement: For Q=sum_i H_i^2, ker Q=intersection_i ker H_i, so all H_i vanish on a common orthogonal complement of dimension d-D, D=rank Q<=Nr. An exact rational basis and rational orthogonal projector restrict the trace-exponential potential to the common support without numerical eigenspace separation. The source's deterministic polynomial-BIT algorithm consequently achieves ||sum_i s_iH_i||<=5*sigma*sqrt(1+ceil(log2(2D))) for nonzero input. For every fixed a, the additional condition N<=r^a yields the requested O_a(sigma*sqrt(log(2r))) rank scale. The constant depends on a and this does not cover unrestricted N; each original matrix still receives one shared sign.

Assign ONE sign to each ORIGINAL H_i, shared by all its eigenvectors/blocks. The full target is a uniform deterministic algorithm with absolute computable C,c, bound C*sigma*sqrt(log(2r)) for nonzero input, and <=C*(N+d+B)^c BIT operations. All-zero inputs return arbitrary signs. No positivity, isotropy, conditioning, spectral gap or lower bound on nonzero sigma is promised. Charge rank/preprocessing, normalization, precision, root/eigenvalue work, all iterations and output; no exact-real, spectral, SDP-value or conditional-expectation oracle or supplied good signs.

costs: For the ambient/joint-support algorithm, form Q exactly; Q=0 returns arbitrary signs. Halve q=Tr Q until the next halving would fail Q<=qI, giving ||Q||<=q<2||Q|| in O(log d) exact rational PSD tests. With u=1+ceil(log2(2d)) or the joint-support u_D, choose dyadic theta with u/4<theta^2 q<=u. Greedily compare the two signs through a trace-exponential potential, each candidate approximated by exact rational Taylor arithmetic to absolute error <=1/(8N). Exponent norms <=(N+1)u give polynomial truncation degree. Fraction-free elimination, rational support/projector construction and dyadic scale selection have polynomial encoding lengths, including arbitrarily small nonzero sigma. Every stated algorithmic cost is polynomial in N+d+B. No implementation was executed by Capital.
